versions.changelog:
- Initial release of farsight-host-scripts skill.
- Automates creation of Farsight host scripts (Intro, Post-Viewers, Conclusion) using consistent narrative style and specific catchphrases.
- Includes a step-by-step protocol: user prompt verification, data analysis, and generation of four structured scripts.
- Ensures host script structure, language, and core messaging align with Farsight project standards.
